description: Route C homogenized order-3 factorization test: are the q-lift kernel candidates C1 (q-involution, [m+2]_q b_{m+2} = b_{m+1} + b_m) or C2 (GGM eq-49) right factors of the homogenized order-3 recurrence of the 4_1 colored Jones? Locates both kernels relative to the actual colored-Jones q-holonomic module.
computation: P1 Habiro sum symbolic sanity; P2 minimal inhomogeneous order-2 recurrence recovered by mod-p undetermined coefficients and CERTIFIED exactly per-m as a Z[q,1/q] Laurent identity for m=2..40 (minimality per garoufalidis-le-2005, not re-proved); P3 homogenization L3 = (beta_{m+1} - beta_m S) o L; P4 exact-rational solution-space membership tests with positive controls; reporting at mp.dps=50

parameters.kill_criterion: EMBEDS iff residual exactly 0 (Fraction) for all m and both fundamental ICs (rel < 1e-40 at dps 50); probe aborts if a positive control fails

recurrence.form: A(q,x) J_{m+1} + B(q,x) J_m + C(q,x) J_{m-1} + E(q,x) = 0, x = q^m; J_1 = 1 Habiro-sum normalization
recurrence.certification: exact integer-Laurent identity per m = 2..40; mod-p guess stage carries no epistemic weight
recurrence.minimality: inhomogeneous order 2 is minimal per garoufalidis-le-2005 (cited, not re-proved); strong AJ for 4_1 per nguyen-tran-2021 (arXiv:2006.02042; PDF proxy-blocked in sandbox, recurrence derived from the Habiro sum instead)

results.verdict: NEITHER EMBEDS: C1 ([m+2]_q b_{m+2} = b_{m+1} + b_m) and GGM eq-49 (y_{m+1} = (2-q^m) y_m - y_{m-1}) solutions, as-is (ungauged), are NOT right factors of the homogenized order-3 colored-Jones operator L3 of 4_1 -- residuals are exact nonzero rationals of relative size O(1) at every tested m, both q values, all ICs. Positive controls (J itself and ker(L_hom)) embed with residual exactly 0, so the order-2 right factor of L3 is the AJ homogeneous part L_hom = (A, B, C), and BOTH q-lift kernel candidates sit OUTSIDE the 4_1 colored-Jones q-holonomic module in the ungauged sense. Scope-(a): non-diagonal GL2 gauges, Mobius transforms, and q-Borel/summation transforms are untested and remain live; nothing here is a 'derivation' of the q-lift.
